about: Shared U6 product policy vectors. TypeScript (packages/core product-policy-vectors.test.ts) and Swift (StillKit ProductPolicyVectorTests) must give exactly these verdicts. Runners evaluate sales with the compiled switch on through a test-only seam; with the shipped switch off every sales vector is compiled_off (or context). A response body is either body (text, UTF-8 encoded by the runner) or bodyHex (raw bytes). When present, padTo appends ASCII spaces until the body is that many bytes. now is the injected clock value. Expectations are hand-authored, never generated from either implementation.
